name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fix: cover art and backdrops never appeared for Plex-sourced federated content. FederationImageProvider only knew how to fetch images from another Jellyfin server running this same plugin - it hotlinked the remote's own '/Plugins/Federation/Peer/Images' route and minted a Federation peer image token, neither of which mean anything to a Plex server, so Plex items silently got no images at all. Images for a non-Jellyfin source now resolve through the same IExternalCatalogProvider abstraction already used for syncing and streaming: a new GetImagesAsync capability reads Plex's own thumb/art paths for an item and builds the token-bearing URL directly, mirroring how video streaming already resolves the file path. 265 tests, all green.
